steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which direction should cause a change in the x value? 

❓ Which direction should cause a change in the y value?

❓ Does the direction button match the direction that the sprite moves in and the direction that the sprite image is facing?


Solution: 

The [on button pressed] containers should be updated so that when the left button is pressed, x is changed by -16 and the sprite is facing left. When the up button is pressed, y is changed by -16, and the sprite is facing backwards (up).
steps.instructions:
When you press the direction buttons, they don’t all work as expected! Some of the buttons make the Player sprite move in the wrong direction and face the wrong way.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the button pressed matches the sprite’s movement on the tilemap.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the Player sprite is able to collect the Mushroom sprite before it disappears!

validationItems.text: Lifespan interval is changed to a value larger than 500
validationItems.failureText: Check the parameter in the [set sprite lifespan] block.

subgroups.name: solve 4

steps.hints: ❓Did you add a new [set sprite to] block in the [on destroyed] container?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓How do you duplicate a block?

❓ In which container should you reset the Mushroom sprite?


Solution: 

The Mushroom sprite’s [set sprite to] block should be duplicated and added to the [on destroyed] container.
steps.instructions:
When the Mushroom sprite is destroyed, it doesn’t appear on the tilemap again!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the Mushroom sprite is set again after it is destroyed.
